property_summary: Depositing through Deposit() never increases any other account's balances (only msg.sender's balance may increase); removing the MinDeposit check allows a malicious Log contract to re-enter on a zero-value or small deposit and cause balances of some other address to increase, so the mutant can violate the invariant that all balances[k] for k != caller remain unchanged after Deposit.
change_summary: Remove the minimum-check so any msg.value (including 0) is accepted; replaces 'if(msg.value >= MinDeposit)' with 'if(true)'.
